pathResolution: manifest,sqlFile,out,deploymentManifest resolve against parameter JSON parent; fixture partition paths resolve against fixture manifest parent. Use absolute paths for reviewed runs.

common.mode: required and must equal CLI mode
common.manifest: required JSON path: deployment for ordinary-sql, fixture for load-runtime-fixture
common.out: required fresh directory; existing output rejected
common.passwordEnv: recommended; explicit environment variable, never archived secret
common.password: optional alternative; redacted from archived parameters

ordinarySql.sqlFile: required exact UTF-8 ordinary SELECT/WITH; executed.sql adds one unique run comment and saves both SHA values
ordinarySql.queryTimeoutSeconds: default180, DEADLINE default1; 1..600; actual JDBC timeout and original server deadlines are archived
ordinarySql.rosterTimeoutMs: default 15000; result drain waits for actual ready roster
ordinarySql.terminalTimeoutSeconds: default 45 for frozen statistics and resource settlement
ordinarySql.requireActualSourceNodeCount: default 2; 0..2; actual ConfigNode IDs and actual DeviceScan FI hosts are checked
ordinarySql.requireGrowShrink: default false; true requires real event INITIAL_ACTIVATED1 -> APPLIED grow -> later APPLIED shrink in one group with supported stable layout
ordinarySql.requireOrderedInitialOne: defaultfalse; true requires each actually observed runtime-group FI frozen splitMode=ORDERED and actualPipelineCount>1, plus supported stable multi-lane group layout initialActivatedWorkers1,maxAppliedWorkers1. Ordinary DEVICE scan plus final sort does not qualify.
ordinarySql.expectedOutcome: default SUCCESS; SUCCESS|CANCELLED|DEADLINE|EXCEPTION. Negative cases require actual unsuccessful FI terminal state, positive real runtime-group activation, all planned FI frozen snapshots and actual resource settlement; disconnect/parse-only failure never qualifies.
ordinarySql.expectedSqlErrorCode: EXCEPTION explicit effective code; CANCELLED715, DEADLINE720. Nonzero JDBC fields authoritative and conflicts reject. Raw0 fallback only exact SQLException, actual fixed ResultSet.next origin, null cause/SQLState, anchored allowed prefix, saved provenance.
ordinarySql.pauseAfterFirstRowMs: default0; DEADLINE1500; CANCELLED max(2000,cancelAfterActivityMs+1500) capped30000; optional0..30000. Only client row-drain pacing, never server/controller mutation.
ordinarySql.cancelAfterActivityMs: CANCELLED only; default500; 0..30000; wait after actual planned FI driver/resource evidence and a live actual DeviceScan source before targeted KILL QUERY
ordinarySql.interventionTimeoutSeconds: CANCELLED only; default30; 1..120; independent ordinary TABLE JDBC connection sends KILL QUERY for exact real internal queryId captured from unique SQL hash roster
ordinarySql.requireHashRepartition: defaultfalse; true requires actual TableHashPartitioningShuffleSinkNode source keys(FI ID+sink node ID), >=2 unique source FIs, actual consistent positive P/routing descriptor, complete unique N x P SINK_CHANNEL and reciprocal EXCHANGE_INPUT edges, P distinct hosted owner FI IDs, real target ExchangeNode and actual aggregation metadata; both actual exchange endpoints verified. P comes from plan, never assumed2.

loadRuntimeFixture.tabletBatchRows: default4096; <=65536; each batch stays within one device cell
loadRuntimeFixture.format: gzip-tsv-v1; exact time/device_id/g/s1/s2 schema and null marker \N
loadRuntimeFixture.freshData: CREATE DATABASE has no IF NOT EXISTS; existing fixture fails instead of appending
loadRuntimeFixture.flush: one explicit successful FLUSH after each of four partitions
loadRuntimeFixture.notProved: Successful Tablet RPC row submissions and partition FLUSH are recorded. SQL table row count, TsFile physical placement and per-region file-size headroom remain separate verification.
loadRuntimeFixture.setupSql: exact three statements from the frozen fixture manifest are executed and archived; IF NOT EXISTS rejected for database
loadRuntimeFixture.timePrecision: actual JDBC open-session time factor must be1000 before fixture writes

discovery: ConfigNode showDataNodes and getDataNodeConfiguration(-1) raw Thrift are archived; actual IDs/endpoints bind JMX and FI roster. Manifest null node IDs are never treated as actual identity.
resultEncoding: Streaming typed compact JSON arrays, UTF-8 LF, integers/NULL preserved. SHA256 covers actual JDBC sequence for successful full drain, or actual captured prefix on execution error. This is order-sensitive and is never a multiset SHA.
proofBoundary: ordinary-sql-receipt is published only after independent terminal/resource collection and all audit windows/client manager/evidence writers close successfully. SUCCESS proves actual full typed sequence capture; expected negative proves actual server SQL termination and FI/resource cleanup. oracleCompared=false and multisetCompared=false always; external oracle/multiset verifier owns correctness. No query graph construction or controller resize mutation.
classpath: Compile both Java files together on the exact server/JDBC/session/isession/tsfile/generated-Thrift/Gson classpath. The new loader adds the existing TableSessionBuilder/ITableSession client dependency.
validation: Portable contract only; final v5 target-host build, strict native constant schema, deadline-cause preservation and service outcomes PENDING.
terminalIntegrity: Each actual terminal response is archived as binary and JSON Thrift before validation; RuntimeSnapshotAdapters recomputes checksum and structured validity. Positive matching APPLIED requested/observed workers only; zero-at-stop never counts as SHRINK.
failureCollection: Original execution failure preserved with suppressed close/evidence failures; actual terminal responses archived before validation; one FI/resource failure does not skip other independent FI/window cleanup. Success receipt withheld on any infrastructure failure.

selfTestSqlErrors.scope: Actual frozen JDBC with in-memory synthetic RPC only.

runtimeEarlyStopEvidence: R3-runtime-constant has no special driver mutation or unsupported flags. Full ordinary-sql capture plus external complete oracle and mandatory read-only runtime-group/partial-source proof are jointly required.
